title: Help-to-buy review finds £25bn social value delivered
summary:
A government audit of the help-to-buy programme has calculated it provided £25bn of social value to the UK in the last financial year, supporting over 387,000 home purchases. The findings come as debate continues within government over whether Labour should introduce its own version of the scheme.

The post Help-to-buy review finds £25bn social value delivered appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: LSL reports 3% revenue growth despite transaction decline
summary:
LSL Property Services has reported a 3% increase in group revenue to £92.3 million for the first half of the year, despite a 4% decline in property transactions. The parent company of Reeds Rains and Your Move recorded an 11% rise in underlying operating profit to £15.9 million, attributing its resilience to diversified income streams.

The post LSL reports 3% revenue growth despite transaction decline appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: LSL Property Services reports 11% profit rise
summary:
LSL Property Services reported an 11% increase in underlying operating profit to £15.9m for the first half of 2026, despite a 4% decline in residential sales transactions. The company's estate agency franchising division achieved a record first-half margin of 30%, supported by restructuring implemented in 2025.

The post LSL Property Services reports 11% profit rise appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Buy-to-let landlords prioritise local markets over yields
summary:
Professional landlords in the UK are concentrating investments in their home regions rather than pursuing higher yields elsewhere, according to new research from Redwood Bank. Analysis of landlord investment patterns between 2021 and 2026 shows professional investors are increasingly focusing on markets where they have local knowledge.

The post Buy-to-let landlords prioritise local markets over yields appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Rising rates threaten landlords on bridging loans
summary:
Landlords who used bridging loans to purchase properties face potential shortfalls as buy-to-let mortgage rates climb and lender stress testing tightens. Average two-year buy-to-let rates have risen to 5.36%, up from 4.88% in September 2025.

The post Rising rates threaten landlords on bridging loans appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Knight Frank opens Derbyshire office with new appointment
summary:
Knight Frank has opened a new office in Melbourne, Derbyshire, appointing Victoria McLaughlin as Sales Director. The move brings the firm's West Midlands office count to eight.

title: London accounts for 43% of overseas company property titles
summary:
London accounts for 43% of all property titles owned by foreign companies in England and Wales, according to research by Benham and Reeves. The analysis reveals that 39,172 of the 91,136 properties registered to overseas companies are located within Greater London.

The post London accounts for 43% of overseas company property titles appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Landmark launches pre-sale surveys ahead of market reforms
summary:
Landmark Information Group has introduced Sales Pack Ready Surveys for estate agents and property professionals, as the UK government prepares to implement reforms aimed at accelerating property transactions. The new service provides RICS-standard assessments of property conditions earlier in the sales process.

The post Landmark launches pre-sale surveys ahead of market reforms appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Leasehold abolition timeline remains unclear, campaign warns
summary:
The National Leasehold Campaign has warned that millions of leaseholders continue to face uncertainty despite government commitments to end the leasehold system. The comments follow Deputy Prime Minister Angela Rayner's statement that legislation would be "coming very soon", though no specific timeline has been provided.

The post Leasehold abolition timeline remains unclear, campaign warns appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Secure Trust Bank provides £5m refinance for Bristol scheme
summary:
Secure Trust Bank Real Estate Finance has completed a £5 million refinancing facility on Lakeshore, a 66-apartment residential scheme in South Bristol. The loan has been structured at 60% loan-to-value and runs for five years.

The post Secure Trust Bank provides £5m refinance for Bristol scheme appeared first on PropertyWire.
